test_pyspiel_load_game: test pyspiel.load_game to load a matrix game by name such as matrix_rps or matrix_pd
test_game_to_nfg_string: test pyspiel.game_to_nfg_string to convert a matrix game to normal-form game text representation
test_nfg_writer_rps: test the nfg writer exports rock-paper-scissors game as a 2-player normal-form game
test_nfg_writer_pd: test the nfg writer exports prisoner's dilemma game as a 2-player normal-form game
test_nfg_writer_3p: test the nfg writer exports matching pennies 3-player game as a 3-player normal-form game
